Each piece measures about 3x2x1.5 cm, which is roughly 9 cm³, or about 9-10 g. Thirteen pieces come to about 120 g.

Fried polenta or cassava runs about 1.5-2 kcal/g. At 120 g that gives roughly 200 kcal. If the pieces are fried cassava, the figure would be closer to 2 kcal/g, so I'll use about 190 kcal.
